key_insight: Deterministically optimized twirling gates shape coherent-error trajectories through destructive interference, keeping accumulated error bounded without logical encoding or ancillary qubits.
engineering_relevance: The framework connects circuit compilation with pulse-level robust control to improve quantum hardware resilience before fault-tolerant operation.
method: Extend pulse-level error geometry to discrete quantum circuits.
Map coherent-error accumulation to trajectories in a high-dimensional error space.
Optimize twirling sequences to cancel errors and combine with robust control pulses.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports bounded O(1) accumulated-error scaling versus O(√N) for randomized compiling, but provides no hardware benchmarks or numerical evaluation details.
watch_item: Performance under realistic mixed noise and the implementation cost of optimized twirling sequences remain unspecified in the abstract.
paper_title: Bridging Pulse and Circuit Levels: A Geometric Framework for Deterministic Error Suppression
